title: NGC 1436: the making of a lenticular galaxy in the Fornax Cluster
question: How and on what timescales is the Fornax cluster galaxy NGC 1436 transitioning from a spiral into a lenticular morphology through environmental interactions?

recipe.goal: Compare HI and CO morphology, spectra, and gas mass ratios
recipe.method: Overlay 11'' and 66'' MeerKAT HI contours and ALMA CO contours on FDS optical image, extract HI spectra using detection masks, compute M_HI using Eq. 50 in Meyer et al. (2017), and compute M_H2/M_HI using M_H2 from Zabel et al. (2021)
key_parameters: PA = 330 deg (major axis), PA = 240 deg (minor axis) for PVDs

recipe.goal: Model HI kinematics and surface brightness profile
recipe.method: Fit the 11'' MeerKAT HI cube using a tilted-ring model in TiRiFiC with a flat disc (single PA and inclination across all rings) and parameter interpolation in groups of rings
key_parameters: Single value for PA and inclination across all rings

recipe.goal: Reconstruct star formation history of inner and outer discs from MUSE spectra
recipe.method: Extract MUSE spectra in 18 inner and 8 outer elliptical annular sectors, fit stellar kinematics with pPXF (4800-5850 A), fit SSP templates and emission lines with GandALF (up to 6850 A) across 20 runs, and bin stellar mass weights into age bins
key_parameters: pPXF wavelength range: 4800 - 5850 A; GandALF extended to 6850 A (masking NaD 5896, 5890 A)
MILES SSP models: age 30 Myr to 14 Gyr, -2.27 <= [M/H] <= 0.4 dex, [alpha/Fe] between 0 and 0.4 dex
Multiplicative polynomial order varied between 6 and 15; age bins: 1-Gyr wide (0-6 Gyr) and 2-Gyr wide (>6 Gyr)
assumptions: Calzetti dust extinction law with Galactic foreground A_V = 0.029
Distance = 20 Mpc and Calzetti et al. (2012) Halpha-to-SFR conversion

score_reason: All underlying raw and reduced survey datasets (MeerKAT, MUSE, ALMA) and analysis codes (TiRiFiC, pPXF, GandALF, MILES) are publicly available, and the spectral fitting choices are thoroughly documented, though exact sector aperture definitions and TiRiFiC ring groupings are not tabulated.
